Deals 10 damage per tick to units. }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Long Ducky''' was an enemy that appeared exclusively in [[D00M's Revenge]] as part of the [[Duck Hunt Event]]. Currently, it can be spawned again in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, however there it copies the modern [[Long Ducky (Ducky Revenge)|Long Ducky]] statistics. It had high health and a below average speed. It had one ability, where it would hit the ground with its head, which created a yellow radial shockwave that stunned towers and damaged units. This ability no longer works in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. Beyond wave 20, its health would increase over time. ==Appearance== The '''Long Ducky''' is a yellow duck with black eyes and an orange beak and feet. It has an abnormally long neck that wobbles. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[D00M's Revenge]] is listed instead. *High damage towers like [[Ranger]] can easily handle this enemy. *Fast firing towers such as the [[Minigunner]] and [[Accelerator]] can also easily deal with the '''Long Ducky'''. **You may also use the [[Commander]] to decrease their firerate. *The [[Medic]] can be used to cleanse stuns from towers caught in the '''Long Ducky's''' shockwave. *Towers with long range are highly recommended because they are usually able to defeat the '''Long Ducky''' before it gets close enough to stun your towers. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseDRLongDucky.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (16 April 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Tower Defense Simulator- Spring Trailer|'''Long Ducky''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} LegacyLongDuckyIconIG.png|'''Long Ducky''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Long Ducky''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''17 April 2022''' - [[v1.2.0]] **'''Long Ducky''' added. *'''28 May 2022''' - [[v1.2.4]] **'''Long Ducky''' removed. *'''16 April 2025''' - [[v1.61.0]] **'''Long Ducky''' can now be summoned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, only when the player has the [[Long Ducky (Ducky Revenge)|Long Ducky]]'s [[Logbooks|Logbook]] from the [[Ducky Revenge Event]]. **{{Bug}} Can no longer uses its ability. ==Notes== {{D00MRevenge2|[[Evil Ducky (D00M's Revenge)|Evil Ducky]]
